texts.text: The warm tea and quiet garden made the afternoon feel peaceful.
I walked home slowly, enjoying the soft rain and empty street.
The library was still, and I had time to read by the window.
We sat calmly on the porch while the evening cooled down.
The final train left before I reached the platform.
The lights went out just as I finished the work.
I returned to find the room empty and the door locked.
The note said our plans had been cancelled without warning.
The whole team cheered when our project won the prize.
Fireworks burst above the crowd as the music began.
My friends arrived laughing with a cake and bright balloons.
We ran outside, clapping as the parade turned the corner.
The clock ticked steadily in the silent office.
A quiet breeze moved the curtains in the empty room.
I sorted the papers slowly beside a dim desk lamp.
The road was empty, and the afternoon passed without change.
